first_condor_attempt.reason: Reference comparison demanded bitwise equality for cross-process muon component products.
first_condor_attempt.diagnosis: Coffea Weights.partial_weight multiplies factors in Python set iteration order; only the twelve MUO component alternatives differed. All other event columns and all Norm fields were identical.
first_condor_attempt.correction: Permit 16 float64 epsilons relatively and zero absolute tolerance only for the twelve component products. Test one-ULP acceptance and rejection of larger changes or any PDF change. Physics code unchanged; new frozen campaign used.

matching.scope: unweighted selected pilot; current processor's ten saved jets

weight_prescription.ps_input_title: PS weights (w_var / w_nominal) [0] isr.murfac=2.0; [1] fsr.murfac=2.0; [2] isr.murfac=0.5; [3] fsr.murfac=0.5
weight_prescription.scale_input_title: LHE scale variation weights (w_var / w_nominal); [0] is renscfact=0.5d0 facscfact=0.5d0 ; [1] is renscfact=0.5d0 facscfact=1d0 ; [2] is renscfact=0.5d0 facscfact=2d0 ; [3] is renscfact=1d0 facscfact=0.5d0 ; [4] is renscfact=1d0 facscfact=1d0 ; [5] is renscfact=1d0 facscfact=2d0 ; [6] is renscfact=2d0 facscfact=0.5d0 ; [7] is renscfact=2d0 facscfact=1d0 ; [8] is renscfact=2d0 facscfact=2d0
weight_prescription.normalization: Signed all-input genWeight * pileup sums; no lepton SF in denominator

muon_efficiency_uncertainties.total: nominal +/- hypot(stat, syst) for ID, isolation and trigger
muon_efficiency_uncertainties.normalization: Nominal denominator; total and components are alternative models

top_pt.top_selection: fromHardProcess and isLastCopy; one t and one tbar; finite nonnegative pT
top_pt.invalid_pair: Unity factors with false validity; retain contribution in every sum
top_pt.input_event_count: Norm/n_input_events; legacy nevents is sum(genWeight) for MC
top_pt.normalization: Signed all-input genWeight * PU * factor; no lepton SF or sigma*L
top_pt.joint_sums: For each saved np_* denominator, store np_topPtWeight_<model>_<suffix>; nominal has no suffix
top_pt.scope: Preserved diagnostics for named ttbar samples including TTBB; not approval for all generators
